categories.name: Sorting
categories.blurb: Watch bars compare, swap and settle into order.

entries.title: Bubble Sort
entries.blurb: Compare neighbours and swap them when out of order; the largest values bubble to the end.

entries.title: Insertion Sort
entries.blurb: Grow a sorted region on the left by shifting larger items and inserting each new key.

entries.title: Selection Sort
entries.blurb: Scan the unsorted tail for the smallest value, then swap it into the next sorted slot.

entries.title: Merge Sort
entries.blurb: Split the range in half, sort each half, then merge the two back in order.

entries.title: Quick Sort
entries.blurb: Partition around a pivot so smaller values move left, then recurse on both sides.

entries.title: Heap Sort
entries.blurb: Build a max-heap in the array, then extract the largest value to the end, one by one.

entries.title: Counting Sort
entries.blurb: Count how often each value occurs, then rewrite the values in order - no comparisons at all.

entries.title: Radix Sort (LSD)
entries.blurb: Three stable counting-sort passes, one per digit; the array settles after the hundreds pass.

categories.name: Searching
categories.blurb: Find a target in a sorted row, one pointer at a time.

entries.title: Linear Search
entries.blurb: Check every cell from left to right until the target is found.

entries.title: Binary Search
entries.blurb: Compare the middle cell and keep the half that can still contain the target.

categories.name: Grid traversal
categories.blurb: Explore a maze: breadth-first, depth-first, or flood fill.

entries.title: Breadth-First Search
entries.blurb: A queue explores the maze in rings; the first path it finds is a shortest path.

entries.title: Depth-First Search
entries.blurb: A stack dives as deep as it can before backing up to the last choice point.

entries.title: Flood Fill
entries.blurb: Paint every open cell connected to the start; walls stop the spread.

categories.name: Data structures
categories.blurb: Stacks, queues and linked lists, seen as they work.

entries.title: Stack (LIFO)
entries.blurb: Push values on, pop them off: the output is the reverse of the input.

entries.title: Queue (FIFO)
entries.blurb: Enqueue at the back and serve from the front: first in, first out.

entries.title: Linked List
entries.blurb: Follow next pointers from the head until the target value is reached.

categories.name: Numbers
categories.blurb: Sieves, Euclid and the Collatz path.

entries.title: Sieve of Eratosthenes
entries.blurb: Cancel the multiples of every prime below 50; what survives is prime.

entries.title: Euclid's GCD
entries.blurb: Write each division as a table row; the last non-zero remainder is the GCD.

entries.title: Collatz Trajectory
entries.blurb: Halve an even number, triple-plus-one an odd one, and watch the path to 1.

categories.name: Recursion
categories.blurb: Call stacks and recursion trees, step by step.

entries.title: Factorial
entries.blurb: Each call pushes a frame; the base case returns 1 and the frames multiply back up.

entries.title: Towers of Hanoi
entries.blurb: The recursion tree: every move happens between two child subtrees.

categories.name: Dynamic programming
categories.blurb: Fill a table cell by cell and read the answer off the edge.

entries.title: 0/1 Knapsack
entries.blurb: Rows are items, columns are capacities; the traceback marks the items taken.

entries.title: Longest Common Subsequence
entries.blurb: Match characters on the diagonal, take the best neighbour otherwise; the path marks the shared subsequence.

entries.title: Edit Distance
entries.blurb: Fewest inserts, deletes and replaces that turn one word into the other.

entries.title: Coin Change
entries.blurb: One cell per amount: the fewest coins that make it.
